description.en: The page number of the detailed consumption (request) records of the consumer within the cycle.

description.en: The number of detailed consumption (request) records per page for the consumer within the cycle. Maximum value: 10.

title.zh: 获取配额规则下某个消费者用量详情
title.en: Retrieve usage details of a consumer under a quota rule

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于获取配额规则下的某个消费者用量详情。注意，只针对于版本大于 2.1.19 的 AI 网关生效。
descriptions.en: Retrieves the usage details of a specific consumer under a quota rule. This operation takes effect only for AI gateways with a version later than 2.1.19.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun apig get-gateway-quota-rule-subject-usage --gateway-id gw-123456 --rule-id qr-d8j7fpmm1hks65kxxxxx --subject-id cs-d8kkaium1xxxxxxxxxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
